sentences.text:
Petit
 Versus
 1. The State of Bihar

2. Pinki Devi W/O Manoj Prasad, D/O Late Dharmendra
 Prasad Resident of village- Harnatar, P.S.- Laukariya, District- West
 Champaran.

... ... Opposite Party/s
 ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Milind Kumar Mishra
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mrs. Pushpa Sinha
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Anjani Kumar Sharan
 Oral Order
4 20-06-2023

Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 and learned A.P.P. for the State.
The petitioner apprehends his arrest in a case registered for the offences punishable under Section 498A, 405, 504 & 506 of the Indian Penal Code.
Petitioner, who is husband of opposite party no2., is said to have ousted the opposite party no.2 from her matrimonial home in association of his family members over the dowry demand.

It is submitted by learned counsel for the Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.72440 of 2022(4)
dt.20-06-2023 petitioner that the petitioner is an innocent person and has committed no offence.
Petitioner has neither made any dowry demand nor drove her out of her matrimonial home nor tormented her over the demand of dowry.

Learned counsel for the petitioner further submitted that Manoj Prasad @ Manoj Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 20 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/118613760/
1 petitioner is ready to make payment of Rs.5,000/- (Rupees Five Thousand) in second week of every succeeding month in the bank account of opposite party no.2 for her maintenance as per the details furnished by her counsel.

entities.text: Manoj Prasad @ Manoj Kumar vs The State Of Bihar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
In that view of the matter, let the above named petitioner, be released on bail, in the event of his arrest or surrender before the learned Court below within a period of six weeks from today, on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Court below where the case is pending/successor Court in connection with Tr.No. 4723 of 2022, arising out of Complaint Case No.345 of 2021,
subject to the condition as laid down under Section 438 (2) of the Cr.P.C., It goes without saying that the aforesaid payment shall be subject to any order being passed in matrimonial, maintenance or any other collateral proceedings.

Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.72440 of 2022(4)
dt.20-06-2023
The present order, in any way, will preclude the parties to resolve the issue otherwise.
It is made clear that if the petitioner fails to make payment on three consecutive dates, the learned court below will be at liberty to cancel the bail bond of the petitioner.
Accordingly, this application stands disposed of.

(Anjani Kumar Sharan, J) Trivedi/-
